routes.semantics: 'blocked' here means NO ROUTE CAN BE CERTIFIED in the measured subgraph under the assumed kappa (intervals that overlap count as not admitted). It does NOT exclude a true non-decreasing path: the strong no-path theorem (blocked_cut_sound) needs every exit certified lower. Lean separates the two (artifacts/proof/CORRESPONDENCE.md, DarwinBridge/Distinction.lean). 'nodes' lists the start/target endpoints, not a path.

collective.question: Does sharing evidence between specialists beat one planner, on the same budget?

arms.label: Shared evidence (5 specialists see each other)

lazysp.scope: Follow-up node-query adaptation of established LazySP; same 100 episodes and 1,000-assay budget. Selectors were declared before this follow-up, after the original experiment. The apparent gain over original Q2C is concentrated in one repeated endpoint pair. This does not establish general superiority. No route certifiable is not biological impossibility.

scale.scope: Separate follow-up on the same repeated-target panel; no clear assay-saving benefit under the tested prior integration. Episode rows and summaries recounted; these runs did not retain per-query traces. Protein model outputs remain predictions; intervals are descriptive seed bootstraps, not calibrated coverage.

proof.theorem: DarwinBridge.routeCert_sound; DarwinBridge.blockedCert_sound (conditional on assumed interval containment)
proof.scope: Lean-checked: proof-worker route certificates, strong blocked certificates (all exits certified lower) and the admissible-cut certificate for core's HTGR>GTVN example ('no certifiable route', weaker); plus the bridged core kappa=2 VFVS>AIKG ROUTE. NOT Lean-checked: the replay's individual episode decisions (they are sound by construction from revealed labels and re-verified against full data in Python). 'Blocked' in core never means 'no true route' (planning/INTEGRATION-FINDINGS.md F1).
proof.assumption: Interval containment is ASSUMED; two replicates do not give simultaneous confidence bands.

limitations: Retrospective replay over already-assayed labels; no new wet-lab measurement and no newly discovered variant
Scores are a growth-selection proxy; not kcat/KM and not a universal fitness
Interval bounds are ASSUMED (kappa); two replicates give no rigorous simultaneous confidence bands over 159,129 variants
Graph scope is the measured four-site subgraph; blocked means blocked there only, never impossible in biology or full sequence space
Node grid coordinates are a projection of (AA1,AA2) x (AA3,AA4), not molecular geometry or an energy surface
The demo figure uses full labels (descriptive); benchmark numbers come only from the saved replay
